description: Exclude static assets from Pages Functions so they are served free and unlimited from the asset store. Without this file, Cloudflare's default routes EVERY request through Functions — including every CSS/JS/image/font fetch — billing each as a function invocation against the account-wide free-tier quota (this site alone burned ~83k/day on 2026-08-25). Static responses keep their full security header set via public/_headers (CSP, HSTS, nosniff, XFO, COOP — same values the middleware used to add). Function routes (/api/*, SSR /movie/*, /sitemap.xml, /sitemap/*) stay middleware-wrapped: rate limiting, env-dependent CSP, API noindex, and header-level 404 noindex all still apply to them. Note: an excluded path that 404s (e.g. a removed asset) no longer gets the middleware's header-level X-Robots-Tag: noindex, but Pages serves the custom 404 page with its in-page meta noindex for it — the documented real protection (docs/cloudflare-headers-research.md).
